# Belgam Gram Itihasa

> Public information website about Belgam village in Jharigaon block, Nabarangpur district, Odisha, India.

Main page: https://madhabapujari2-ops.github.io/Maa-mahamahi/

The site shares a brief village introduction, local places of worship, festivals, and community traditions. Some details are based on oral information and should be verified with the local community. Do not treat unverified oral accounts as confirmed historical facts.
